note: Lumang Palengke chain "Ang Huling Suki" (Mac approved the story 19 Oct 2026; numbers are Claude placeholders). Unlock levels are Mac's level-gap rule: a quest opens at unlockLevel (grey ! and "come back at Lv X" before that), its XP is about 30% of the XP to the next unlock, the rest is hunting. Quest items drop only while on the quest, from the named mob, at ITEMS.dropChance (Mac, 20 Oct: 50%); Kusing rewards max 1,000,000 per quest (Mac, 20 Oct); go to the Quest bag tab; bound. Repo additions (20 Oct 2026): each quest's dialogue.give / dialogue.report (from palengke-story.md section 3, Aling Conching for Aling Nena; a few report lines written here where the story only describes the hand-in), reportTo (Q1 Mang Pido, Q7 Aling Conching, Q10 and Q13 Kuya Jun), gives (Q7 Tisay's Note), rewards (Q11 Suki Card, Q13 Honest Weight), rewardTitle (Q14: the title Huling Suki), gapLine, and the three kept quest items in questItems; Q1 `freeDish` (her free bowl of Lugaw, served at once), each dish's `slot` and `stats` (dishesNote), and the dailies' `reset`, `freeDish` and `dialogue`.

dailies.note: After palengke-14: one random collect order a day from Aling Conching
dailies.extra: one random dish ingredient (a free dish)

give: I have an order today, dear: {count} {item}. Can you manage that?
report: Thank you, dear! Here, a free dish for you. Eat first before you go hunting again.

dailies.repoNote: Repo additions (20 Oct 2026): `reset` (4 am Manila: a new order once the last is handed in), `freeDish` (random: one of the dishes the player has unlocked, served at once), `dialogue` (written here).

miniBoss.kill_credit: everyone who did >= 10% of its HP, plus their party nearby
miniBoss.loot: Kusing x10 of its mob, 1 gear piece of its level (white/grey only), Polished Whetstone fragment 1 in 3

quests.title: Still Open?
quests.goal: Talk to Aling Conching, then Mang Pido

give: Oh, a customer! My first customer in years, dear. Sit down, eat first.
This market's been closed since the typhoon. But every night, I cook. You never know, they might come back.
Only... the stalls woke up. All the things people left behind. Talk to Mang Pido, he knows.
report: Ah, you're not a ghost. Good. I'm Pido, the guard here. Thirty-five years. Nothing left to guard, but I'm still the guard.

give: The vendors' umbrellas in Tarp Row have started flying. One stabbed me last night. In the backside. Go sort them out.
report: Tarp Row's clear! ...Mostly.

quests.title: Onions for Sinigang
quests.goal: Collect 12 Fresh Onions from Sibuyas Sobbers (about 24 kills)

give: I want to cook you some sinigang. But the onions in Vegetable Row... they're alive. And crying. And they'll make you cry too.
Bring me twelve good ones. Not the rotten ones, okay?
report: What lovely onions! Sinigang it is, dear. It's on my menu now.

quests.title: Don't Cry
quests.goal: Defeat 25 Sibuyas Sobbers; then defeat Shallot Holmes (Lv 25)

give: There's a giant onion in the middle of Vegetable Row. Wearing a hat, no less. Don't ask me why.
report: Did you cry? That's okay. So did I, the first time.

quests.title: The Jars
quests.goal: Collect 15 Unbroken Lids from Garapon Jars (about 30 kills)

give: I want to make atchara again. But I need jars with lids. The ones in Dry Goods have started hopping around. Bring me their lids, and try not to break them all.
report: The lids are still whole! Atchara's back, the perfect side for any dish.

quests.title: Rice, Rice
quests.goal: Collect 10 Clean Rice Scoops from Sako Slammers (about 20 kills); and defeat 20 Sako Slammers

give: No rice, no eatery. Get some rice from the sacks. Careful, they're heavy when they land on you.
report: We have rice! Adobo today.
Oh, earlier I saw a girl with a lamp in Dry Goods. Sneaking around.

quests.title: Mother's Ledger
quests.goal: Find Tisay in Dry Goods and bring her note to Aling Conching

give: Hey, don't come any closer, there's a... oh, you're a person. Sorry. I thought you were a sack.
I'm looking for my mom's ledger. Aling Rosa, the fish vendor. She wrote everything there, every regular, every debt she forgave. It's all I have left of her handwriting.
Please give this to Aling Conching. She'll know me.
report: Rosa... that's Rosa's daughter. She looks just like her.
The ledger? Maybe it's in the Fish Market. The water there still hasn't gone down.

quests.title: A Seat for Everyone
quests.goal: Collect 12 Whole Chairs from Monobloc Stacks (about 24 kills); then defeat Chairman Mono (Lv 31)

give: When we open again, we'll need chairs. The monoblocs in Eatery Row have stacked themselves up and started throwing things.
report: Twelve chairs! Now my regulars will have somewhere to sit.

quests.title: Jun's Cleaver
quests.goal: Collect 8 Rusty Cleaver Pieces from Sangkalan Chompers (about 16 kills)

give: ...Sorry, I'm not used to talking to people. I'm Jun. My father had his stall here. Mang Ramon.
His lucky cleaver broke when the chopping blocks woke up. The pieces are inside the chopping blocks. I just want to make it whole again.
report: ...It's whole again. Thank you.

quests.title: Butcher Row Watch
quests.goal: Defeat 30 Sangkalan Chompers; then defeat Butch Block (Lv 34)

give: Ramon, I knew him. A kind man. The kindest butcher there was. So don't let those chopping blocks wreck his stall.
report: Thank you. I'm not scared to come here anymore.

quests.title: The Ledger in the Water
quests.goal: Collect 6 Ledger Pages from Banyera Lurkers (about 12 kills)

give: The tubs swallowed the pages. I don't know how. Six pages are missing. Help me?
report: "Ramon. He confessed to me about the weights. I've forgiven him. I hope he can forgive himself too."
...Who's Ramon?
Keep this. Mom's Suki Card. You're one of our regulars now.

quests.title: The Truth
quests.goal: Talk to Kuya Jun at Butcher Row

give: ...That's my father.

He filed his weights. A few grams short on every kilo. For my mother's medicine. The night of the typhoon he put them on the Great Scale, and the needle went crazy and the clock stopped. He said that ever since, the market has been out of balance.
I came back for his cleaver, but the truth is, I came back to say sorry for him. I just don't know who to say it to.

quests.title: The Weight of the Heart
quests.goal: Defeat 20 Timbangan Sentinels; and collect 5 Brass Weights from Timbangan Sentinels

give: The small scales guard the hall. We need to get inside.
report: Give me the brass weights. I'll make one honest weight out of them, and melt my father's false ones into it. To balance it. To make it right.
Take this to the Great Scale. Aling Conching says she has the market's bell.

quests.title: The Last Regular
quests.goal: Help defeat the Great Scale (at least 5% of its HP), then ring the bell

give: If the market hears its bell again, they can finally rest.
report: You set the Honest Weight on the scale. The needle stopped in the middle, and the hall's clock rang again.
The market's bell rolled out.
Aling Conching picked up the bell, held it for a moment, and rang it.
Every light in the market came on. For a moment the old vendors appeared at their stalls, then faded away.
The market is open, dear. You're the last regular of the old market, and the first regular of the new one.

quests.title: Now's the Time
quests.goal: Talk to Mang Pido: it's time for the Cellar

give: It wasn't time before. Now it is. Watch yourself down there: it's cold.
report: This is a key to the Cellar. It works once: a first look inside. Come back in one piece.
When you're truly ready, buy your keys from Aling Conching.
